quote: Psychological LLMs have emerged that integrate domain-specific expertise and simulate human counselor interactions, significantly lowering the barriers to psychological counseling.

This paper aims to equip psychological LLMs with context-aware proactive questioning capabilities for timely intervention in psychological conversations.
